query:
UPDATE auth_security_settings
            SET admin_password_policy = $1,
                user_password_policy = $2,
                pin_policy = $3,
                device_trust_policy = $4,
                updated_at = NOW(),
                updated_by = $5
            WHERE id = $6
            RETURNING
                admin_password_policy,
                user_password_policy,
                pin_policy,
                device_trust_policy,
                updated_at,
                updated_by
